name: disaster-response
description: Coordinate emergency response for natural disasters including earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, and severe weather events

name: cyber-alert
description: Escalate cybersecurity incidents including CVEs, ransomware attacks, data breaches, and known exploited vulnerabilities

name: infrastructure-check
description: Assess damage to internet, power, transportation, and communication networks during outages or attacks

name: maritime-redirect
description: Reroute vessels and maritime traffic away from hazardous zones, conflict areas, or environmental disasters

name: aircraft-grounding
description: Issue no-fly orders or reroute aircraft around dangerous airspace, volcanic ash, or severe weather

name: space-debris-warn
description: Alert satellite operators and space agencies about geomagnetic storms, debris, or orbital collisions

name: threat-intel-brief
description: Compile and distribute intelligence briefings on correlated threats, active CVEs, and emerging attack patterns

name: public-health-alert
description: Issue health warnings and coordinate medical response for biological threats, pandemics, or environmental hazards
